SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ......... 8610
Section 1, Special Branch.........Station,
REPORT                          Date August 23, 19 38.

Subject...Letter dated 17.8.38 addressed by Mr. A.L. Epstein to the British
Consulate-General concerning M. Osipoff and A. Petroff.
Made by. D.S.I. Prokofiev................Forwarded by. [Signature]

Enquiries show that the court case referred to in
Mr. Epstein's letter is a private criminal prosecution
instituted at the Second Shanghai Special District Court
in May, 1938 by Mr. A. KASAKIN, Russian, residing in Harbin,
against 1) M.V. OSIPOFF, Russian, employee of the Discount
Savings Bank, 465 Avenue Joffre; 2) A. A. PETROFF, Russian,
c/o M. V. Osipoff, and 3) N. KOLESNICHENKO, naturalized
Chinese citizen of Russian origin, 373 Avenue du Roi Albert.

The complainant is represented by Mr. A.L. Epstein
and Messrs. Osipoff and Petroff - by Mr. E. N. Shendrikoff.

It is alleged by the prosecution that several years
ago Osipoff, Petroff and another Russian named Gubonin, being
share-holders and directors of the Thriftcor Bank in Harbin
(closed in 1935) unlawfully remitted as their own deposits
the sum of Y.60,000 to the Shanghai branch of the same bank
(also closed either in 1935 or 1936). Upon the complainant
becoming aware of this, he took certain steps as a result
of which Osipoff and Petroff signed an agreement in December,
1935 at Harbin, by which the said sum was transferred to the
complainant.

However, the complainant was unable to recover the money
in question from the Liquidators of the Shanghai Branch of
the Thriftcor Bank. In March, 1936 he was induced by Osipoff
to issue a power of attorney to the latter for the purpose of
recovering the said sum from the Liquidators of the Shanghai
branch of the Thriftcor Bank, with which Osipoff claimed to
have good connections. Arriving in Shanghai with the power
of attorney Osipoff in May, 1936 engaged N. Kolesnichenko,

上海公共租界工部局警务处。档案号……8610
特务科第一股……分局，
报告                          日期 1938年8月23日。

事由……A.L. Epstein先生于1938年8月17日致英国总领事馆关于M. Osipoff和A. Petroff的信函。
制作人：特别调查员 Prokofiev………………转呈人：[签名]

经查，Epstein先生信函中提及的诉讼案件系由居住在哈尔滨的俄国人A. KASAKIN先生于1938年5月在上海第二特区地方法院提起的私人刑事自诉，被告为：1) M.V. OSIPOFF，俄国人，霞飞路465号贴现储蓄银行（Discount Savings Bank）职员；2) A. A. PETROFF，俄国人，通讯处为M. V. Osipoff；以及3) N. KOLESNICHENKO，原籍俄国、已归化为中国公民，阿尔贝王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）373号。

自诉人由A.L. Epstein先生代理，Osipoff先生和Petroff先生由E. N. Shendrikoff先生代理。

检方指控称，数年前，Osipoff、Petroff及另一名名为Gubonin的俄国人作为哈尔滨节俭银行（Thriftcor Bank，该银行于1935年关闭）的股东和董事，非法将总额为60,000元的款项作为其个人存款汇至该银行的上海分行（该分行亦于1935年或1936年关闭）。自诉人获悉此事后，采取了一定措施，致使Osipoff和Petroff于1935年12月在哈尔滨签署了一份协议，据此将上述款项转让给自诉人。

然而，自诉人未能从节俭银行上海分行的清算人处追回上述款项。1936年3月，他受Osipoff诱导，向后者出具了一份授权委托书，目的是通过Osipoff声称与之有良好关系的渠道，从节俭银行上海分行的清算人处追回上述款项。Osipoff持该授权委托书于1936年5月抵达上海后，聘请了N. Kolesnichenko，

当地律师，同时也是节俭银行上海分行的清算人之一，旨在为自诉人追回上述款项。指控称，他未履行其职责，因此，自诉人现对这三名相关人员提出如下指控：
(1) M. V. OSIPOFF - 侵占及背信。
《中华民国刑法》第28、335及342条。
(2) A. A. PETROFF - 与Osipoff共同参与侵占。
《中华民国刑法》第28及335条。
(3) N. KOLESNICHENKO - 背信。
《中华民国刑法》第28、336(2)及342条。
该案于1938年5月25日和6月8日在上海第二特区地方法院第二法庭审理。看来在后一日期，因检方需提交某些数据，案件审理中止。

REPORT
Date August 22. 19 38.

Subject (in full) Result of enquiries at French Police re attached letter.

Made by and Forwarded by Inspector Papp.

Referring to the attached letter, Mr. Plessis,
Sous-Directeur Chef de la Sûreté, on being questioned,
stated that "absolutely" nothing is known to the French
Police regarding the case mentioned in the attached letter
nor is there anything known against the persons named
therein.

G. Papp
Inspector.

D. C. (Special Branch).
